blocks.zh: Section 4: General Quality Risk Management Process｜一般品質風險管理流程
blocks.en: Section 4: General Quality Risk Management Process

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握 QRM 完整循環流程：啟動 → 風險評估（識別 / 分析 / 評估）→ 風險控制（降低 / 接受）→ 風險溝通 → 風險審查
blocks.en: Master the complete QRM cycle: initiation → risk assessment (identification / analysis / evaluation) → risk control (reduction / acceptance) → risk communication → risk review

blocks.zh: 理解 4.1 責任劃分：跨職能團隊組成，以及 Q9(R1) 新增的「管理與最小化主觀性」要求
blocks.en: Understand 4.1 Responsibilities: the composition of interdisciplinary teams, and the requirement added in Q9(R1) to manage and minimize subjectivity

blocks.zh: 熟悉 4.3 風險評估 三大核心問題，並區分定量 vs. 定性輸出的應用場景
blocks.en: Become familiar with the three core questions of 4.3 Risk Assessment, and distinguish when to use quantitative vs. qualitative outputs

blocks.zh: 理解 Probability × Severity × Detectability = RPN 的邏輯，以及不確定性（Uncertainty）的來源
blocks.en: Understand the logic of Probability × Severity × Detectability = RPN, and the sources of uncertainty

blocks.zh: 掌握 4.4 風險控制 四大決策問題，尤其是「降低風險可能引入新風險」的矛盾現象
blocks.en: Master the four decision questions of 4.4 Risk Control, especially the paradox that "reducing a risk may introduce a new risk"

blocks.zh: 認識 4.5 風險溝通 與 4.6 風險審查 在持續品質管理體系中的角色
blocks.en: Recognize the roles of 4.5 Risk Communication and 4.6 Risk Review in a continuous quality management system

blocks.zh: Section 4 Overview｜QRM 框架總覽
blocks.en: Section 4 Overview: The QRM Framework

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 「Unacceptable」不只是法規不合規：即使風險沒有違反任何法規，只要超出組織設定的內部可接受標準，也需要重回風險評估步驟。這是一個以科學和業務標準為基礎的自我要求，而非僅是法規底線。
blocks.en: "Unacceptable" is not only about regulatory non-compliance: even if a risk breaches no regulation, if it exceeds the organization's own internal acceptance criteria, you must return to the risk assessment step. This is a self-imposed requirement based on science and business standards, not merely a regulatory floor.

blocks.zh: 非線性流程：任何節點都可以做出「退回上一步」的決策，QRM 是一個循環迭代的過程，不是單向直線。
blocks.en: A non-linear process: a decision to "go back a step" can be made at any node. QRM is an iterative cycle, not a one-way straight line.

blocks.zh: 「Other models could be used」：Q9(R1) 沒有強制要求特定工具；組織可根據風險性質選用 FMEA、FTA、HACCP 等（見 Section 5）。
blocks.en: "Other models could be used": Q9(R1) does not mandate a specific tool; organizations may choose FMEA, FTA, HACCP and others according to the nature of the risk (see Section 5).

blocks.zh: 4.1 Responsibilities｜責任劃分
blocks.en: 4.1 Responsibilities

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 跨職能團隊（Interdisciplinary Teams）：QRM 不是 QA 部門的「獨角戲」。原文列舉的部門涵蓋 Quality、R&D、Business Dev、Engineering、Regulatory、Production、Sales、Supply Chain、Legal、Statistics、Clinical——幾乎是整個公司。不同視角的人對同一個風險會有完全不同的解讀，這正是跨職能的必要性所在。
blocks.en: Interdisciplinary teams: QRM is not a one-man show for the QA department. The functions listed in the original text include Quality, R&D, Business Development, Engineering, Regulatory, Production, Sales, Supply Chain, Legal, Statistics and Clinical, which is almost the whole company. People with different perspectives will read the same risk very differently, and that is exactly why a cross-functional team is needed.

blocks.zh: Decision Makers 的三大職責：① 協調跨部門 QRM → ② 確保流程被定義、部署、審查 → ③ 管理並最小化主觀性（Q9(R1) 新增）。第三點是 R1 修訂的重要補充。
blocks.en: The three responsibilities of decision makers: (1) coordinate QRM across functions, (2) ensure that the process is defined, deployed and reviewed, and (3) manage and minimize subjectivity (new in Q9(R1)). The third point is an important addition made by the R1 revision.

blocks.zh: Q9(R1) 新增重點：主觀性管理
blocks.en: New in Q9(R1): Managing Subjectivity

blocks.zh: 原版 Q9 沒有明確討論主觀性問題。R1 修訂版在 4.1 中加入了要求決策者必須「assure that subjectivity... is managed and minimized」。
blocks.en: The original Q9 did not explicitly discuss subjectivity. The R1 revision adds a requirement in 4.1 that decision makers must "assure that subjectivity... is managed and minimized".

blocks.zh: 為什麼重要？風險評分（如 RPN）在很大程度上依賴評分者的主觀判斷。不同人對「嚴重性 = 7 還是 8」可能有完全不同的標準。R1 要求組織應建立機制來管理這種主觀性，例如：
blocks.en: Why does it matter? Risk scores (such as RPN) depend heavily on the scorer's subjective judgment. Different people may apply very different standards when deciding whether severity is a 7 or an 8. R1 expects organizations to establish mechanisms to manage this subjectivity, for example:

blocks.zh: 建立統一的評分標準和定義（定義「高/中/低」的具體準則）
blocks.en: Establish uniform scoring criteria and definitions (specific criteria that define "high / medium / low")

blocks.zh: 使用多位評分者並求平均或共識
blocks.en: Use multiple scorers and take the average or a consensus

blocks.zh: 引用歷史數據、文獻等客觀依據支持評分
blocks.en: Support scores with objective evidence such as historical data and literature

blocks.zh: 對評分結果進行同儕審查（peer review）
blocks.en: Subject the scoring results to peer review

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application in a CDMO

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，跨職能 QRM 團隊的組建尤其複雜，因為需要整合客戶端代表（Client QA / Regulatory）與CDMO 端專家（製程工程師、分析化學家、法規專員）。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, assembling a cross-functional QRM team is especially complex, because it must bring together client representatives (Client QA / Regulatory) and CDMO experts (process engineers, analytical chemists, regulatory affairs specialists).

blocks.zh: 技術轉移 QRM：啟動一個新客戶案時，應立即組建跨職能 QRM 小組，識別技術轉移風險（工藝參數差異、設備匹配度、分析方法驗證）
blocks.en: Technology transfer QRM: when starting a new client project, set up a cross-functional QRM team immediately to identify technology transfer risks (process parameter differences, equipment fit, analytical method validation).

blocks.zh: 主觀性管理實例：CDMO 可建立「Risk Scoring Matrix」工作表，要求所有評分者對每個風險項目先各自獨立評分，再召開討論會議解決分歧——這符合 Q9(R1) 對「管理主觀性」的要求
blocks.en: Example of managing subjectivity: a CDMO can set up a "Risk Scoring Matrix" worksheet that requires every scorer to score each risk item independently first, and then hold a discussion meeting to resolve differences. This meets the Q9(R1) requirement to "manage subjectivity".

blocks.zh: 4.2 Initiating a QRM Process｜啟動品質風險管理流程
blocks.en: 4.2 Initiating a QRM Process

blocks.zh: CDMO 案例：客戶更換 API 供應商
blocks.en: CDMO Case: Client Changes API Supplier

blocks.zh: 當客戶通知 CDMO「我們要更換 API 供應商」時，CDMO 應立即啟動 QRM 流程：
blocks.en: When a client tells the CDMO "we are changing our API supplier", the CDMO should immediately initiate a QRM process:

blocks.zh: Risk Question：「新供應商的 API（批次 ABC-001 至 ABC-005）是否能在現有製程條件下，生產出符合所有 CQA 規格的最終產品？」
blocks.en: Risk Question: "Can the new supplier's API (batches ABC-001 to ABC-005) be used under the current process conditions to produce a finished product that meets all CQA specifications?"

blocks.zh: 背景資料：新 API 的 CoA（雜質剖面、粒徑分布、多晶型），與舊 API 的比較數據，現有製程的 Design Space 參數
blocks.en: Background information: the new API's CoA (impurity profile, particle size distribution, polymorphic form), comparative data against the old API, and the design space parameters of the current process

blocks.zh: 負責人：製程工程師（Lead）+ 分析化學家 + QA + 客戶 RA 代表
blocks.en: Responsible persons: process engineer (lead) + analytical chemist + QA + client RA representative

blocks.zh: 時程：4 週完成初步 Risk Assessment；決策層級：CDMO Site Head + 客戶 VP of Quality
blocks.en: Timeline: initial Risk Assessment completed within 4 weeks; decision-making level: CDMO Site Head + client VP of Quality

blocks.zh: 4.3 Risk Assessment｜風險評估（最核心章節）
blocks.en: 4.3 Risk Assessment (the Most Important Section)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：醫生診斷三步驟 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy: The Doctor's Three-Step Diagnosis

blocks.zh: 風險評估就像醫生診斷疾病，分三個步驟：
blocks.en: Risk assessment is like a doctor diagnosing a disease, in three steps:

blocks.zh: 危害識別（Hazard Identification）= 問診/症狀識別：你哪裡不舒服？可能是什麼問題？（What might go wrong?）——醫生問「你頭痛多久了？有沒有發燒？」就是在做危害識別。
blocks.en: Hazard Identification = taking the history / identifying symptoms: Where does it hurt? What might the problem be? (What might go wrong?) When the doctor asks "How long have you had the headache? Do you have a fever?", that is hazard identification.

blocks.zh: 風險分析（Risk Analysis）= 嚴重程度評估：這個症狀有多嚴重？多常發生？（Probability × Severity）——「這個頭痛是偶爾還是持續？輕微還是劇烈？」就是在做風險分析。
blocks.en: Risk Analysis = assessing how serious it is: How severe is the symptom? How often does it occur? (Probability × Severity) "Is the headache occasional or constant? Mild or severe?" is risk analysis.

blocks.zh: 風險評估（Risk Evaluation）= 判斷是否需要治療：和健康標準比較，決定是否需要介入。（Is treatment needed?）——醫生決定「這需要立即住院 vs. 先觀察幾天」就是 Risk Evaluation。
blocks.en: Risk Evaluation = deciding whether treatment is needed: compare against health standards and decide whether intervention is needed. (Is treatment needed?) When the doctor decides "this needs immediate hospitalization vs. observe for a few days first", that is Risk Evaluation.

blocks.zh: 沒有正確的「症狀識別」（危害識別），後面的診斷（分析）和治療決策（評估）都會走偏。
blocks.en: Without correct "symptom identification" (hazard identification), the later diagnosis (analysis) and treatment decision (evaluation) will go astray.

blocks.zh: 不確定性（Uncertainty）的管理
blocks.en: Managing Uncertainty

blocks.zh: Q9(R1) 對「不確定性」的處理是 R1 修訂的核心主題之一。來源包括：
blocks.en: Q9(R1) treats "uncertainty" as one of the core themes of the R1 revision. Its sources include:

blocks.zh: 知識缺口：對製程機制理解不足（如新工藝尚無歷史數據）
blocks.en: Knowledge gaps: insufficient understanding of process mechanisms (for example, a new process with no historical data)

blocks.zh: 藥學科學缺口：如新型輔料的相容性尚未完全研究
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical science gaps: for example, the compatibility of a new excipient has not been fully studied

blocks.zh: 失效模式：製程中可能出現但未被識別的故障模式
blocks.en: Failure modes: failure modes that may occur in the process but have not been identified

blocks.zh: 檢測概率：某些危害難以被現有分析方法偵測到
blocks.en: Probability of detection: some hazards are difficult to detect with existing analytical methods

blocks.zh: 實務建議：在 FMEA 工作表中，應明確標注每一個評分的「信心水準」（Confidence Level）或「數據來源」。若某項評分主要依靠「informed opinion」而非實測數據，應在 Risk Assessment Report 中標注為「高不確定性」，並建議進行驗證實驗。
blocks.en: Practical advice: in an FMEA worksheet, clearly state the "confidence level" or "data source" for each score. If a score relies mainly on "informed opinion" rather than measured data, flag it as "high uncertainty" in the Risk Assessment Report and recommend verification experiments.

blocks.zh: 風險量化公式與輸出類型 Risk Output Types
blocks.en: Risk Quantification Formula and Output Types

blocks.zh: 定量方法（FMEA 典型公式）：
blocks.en: Quantitative method (typical FMEA formula):

blocks.zh:
RPN = Severity (S) × Probability (P) × Detectability (D)

S: 1-10（1=無影響，10=最嚴重）
P: 1-10（1=幾乎不可能，10=幾乎確定）
D: 1-10（1=幾乎必然被檢出，10=幾乎不可能被發現）
RPN 範圍：1 ~ 1000

注意：D 值越高代表越難偵測（與 S/P 相反）
常見閾值：RPN ≥ 100 → 需要採取行動
blocks.en:
RPN = Severity (S) × Probability (P) × Detectability (D)

S: 1-10 (1 = no impact, 10 = most severe)
P: 1-10 (1 = almost impossible, 10 = almost certain)
D: 1-10 (1 = almost certain to be detected, 10 = almost impossible to detect)
RPN range: 1 to 1000

Note: a higher D value means harder to detect (the opposite of S/P)
Common threshold: RPN ≥ 100 → action required

blocks.en: Comparison of quantitative vs. qualitative outputs:

blocks.zh: 4.4 Risk Control｜風險控制
blocks.en: 4.4 Risk Control

blocks.zh: 風險補償悖論（Risk Compensation Paradox）
blocks.en: The Risk Compensation Paradox

blocks.zh: 「降低風險可能引入新風險」是 4.4 中最重要也最容易被忽略的概念。幾個真實案例類比：
blocks.en: "Reducing a risk may introduce a new risk" is the most important and most easily overlooked concept in 4.4. A few real-life analogies:

blocks.zh: 無菌工藝案例：為了降低微生物污染風險，引入紫外線照射步驟 → 新風險：UV 降解 API，影響效力（增加了化學降解的風險）
blocks.en: Aseptic process example: to reduce the risk of microbial contamination, a UV irradiation step is introduced → new risk: UV degrades the API and affects potency (increased risk of chemical degradation)

blocks.zh: 過濾案例：新增一道除菌過濾以降低生物負荷 → 新風險：過濾器相容性問題，可濾出物（Extractables）污染藥液
blocks.en: Filtration example: an additional sterilizing filtration step is added to reduce bioburden → new risk: filter compatibility problems, and extractables contaminating the drug solution

blocks.zh: 自動化案例：引入自動灌裝系統降低人為操作風險 → 新風險：設備故障模式增加，電腦化系統驗證（CSV）需求增加
blocks.en: Automation example: an automated filling system is introduced to reduce the risk of human intervention → new risk: more equipment failure modes and greater computerized system validation (CSV) needs

blocks.zh: 結論：每當實施風險降低措施後，必須重新進行風險評估（revisit risk assessment），評估是否引入了新風險或放大了其他既有風險。這形成了 QRM 的「內迴圈」。
blocks.en: Conclusion: whenever a risk reduction measure is implemented, the risk assessment must be revisited to evaluate whether a new risk has been introduced or other existing risks have been amplified. This forms the "inner loop" of QRM.

blocks.zh: Risk Reduction vs. Risk Acceptance 的選擇
blocks.en: Choosing Between Risk Reduction and Risk Acceptance

blocks.zh: 風險控制的兩個出口：降低（Risk Reduction）或接受（Risk Acceptance）。
blocks.en: Risk control has two exits: Risk Reduction or Risk Acceptance.

blocks.zh: 接受風險並不意味著「放棄管理」，而是一個有意識的、有文件記錄的決策——「我們已充分評估此風險，認為其在當前可接受範圍內，以下是我們的依據...」
blocks.en: Accepting a risk does not mean "giving up on managing it". It is a conscious, documented decision: "We have fully assessed this risk and consider it acceptable at present; the following is our rationale..."

blocks.zh: 對比：未記錄的「接受」（即什麼都不做）是 GMP 的不符合項；有充分文件支持的 Risk Acceptance 是完全合規的 QRM 輸出。
blocks.en: By contrast, an undocumented "acceptance" (that is, doing nothing) is a GMP non-conformance, whereas a well-documented Risk Acceptance is a fully compliant QRM output.

blocks.zh: 4.5 Risk Communication｜風險溝通
blocks.en: 4.5 Risk Communication

blocks.zh: 虛線箭頭（Dashed Arrows）的意義：在 Figure 1 流程圖中，風險溝通用「虛線」而非「實線」表示，代表它可以發生在任何階段，而不是只在特定節點。這與單向流程的「實線」不同。
blocks.en: The meaning of the dashed arrows: in the Figure 1 flowchart, risk communication is shown with "dashed lines" rather than solid lines, meaning it can occur at any stage and not only at specific nodes. This differs from the "solid lines" of a one-way flow.

blocks.zh: 溝通對象多元：法規機關 ↔ 業界、業界 ↔ 患者、公司內部部門間、CDMO ↔ 客戶——不同對象需要不同深度和格式的溝通。
blocks.en: A variety of audiences: regulators ↔ industry, industry ↔ patients, between departments within a company, CDMO ↔ client. Different audiences need different depth and format of communication.

blocks.zh: 「不是每個風險接受都需要溝通」：這是實務上非常重要的比例原則。低風險的日常 Risk Acceptance 可以內部記錄即可，不需要每次都正式通報法規機關或啟動跨部門溝通。
blocks.en: "Not every risk acceptance needs to be communicated": this is a very important proportionality principle in practice. Routine low-risk Risk Acceptance can simply be recorded internally, without a formal notification to regulators or cross-functional communication every time.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：文件化是溝通的核心
blocks.en: Key Point: Documentation Is the Core of Communication

blocks.zh: 「Communicated and documented」——Q9(R1) 強調 QRM 的輸出必須被記錄。
blocks.en: "Communicated and documented": Q9(R1) emphasizes that QRM outputs must be recorded.

blocks.zh: 記錄不只是合規要求，更是知識管理的工具。未來的風險審查（4.6）、稽核、法規查廠都依賴完整的 QRM 記錄。
blocks.en: Records are not only a compliance requirement but also a knowledge management tool. Future risk reviews (4.6), audits and regulatory inspections all depend on complete QRM records.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應建立 QRM 報告模板，確保每個 QRM 活動都有標準格式的輸出文件（Risk Assessment Report、Risk Control Plan、Risk Review Summary）。
blocks.en: A CDMO should establish QRM report templates to ensure that every QRM activity has a standard-format output document (Risk Assessment Report, Risk Control Plan, Risk Review Summary).

blocks.zh: 對法規機關的溝通應透過「現有管道」（existing channels），如 CBE-30、Prior Approval Supplement、DMF update——不需要另外開闢新的溝通路徑。
blocks.en: Communication with regulators should go through "existing channels", such as CBE-30, Prior Approval Supplement and DMF update. There is no need to open new communication paths.

blocks.zh: 4.6 Risk Review｜風險審查
blocks.en: 4.6 Risk Review

blocks.zh: 審查頻率與風險等級掛鉤
blocks.en: Review Frequency Is Tied to Risk Level

blocks.zh: 「The frequency of any review should be based upon the level of risk」——這是一個比例原則（proportionality principle）：
blocks.en: "The frequency of any review should be based upon the level of risk": this is a proportionality principle:

blocks.zh: 高風險事項（High Risk）：如無菌工藝關鍵控制點、滅菌參數 → 每季或每次批次審查
blocks.en: High risk: for example, critical control points in aseptic processing and sterilization parameters → review every quarter or every batch

blocks.zh: 中風險事項（Medium Risk）：如輔料供應商資格 → 每半年或年度審查
blocks.en: Medium risk: for example, excipient supplier qualification → review every six months or annually

blocks.zh: 低風險事項（Low Risk）：如外箱包材規格 → 3 年或變更時審查
blocks.en: Low risk: for example, outer carton packaging specifications → review every 3 years or upon change

blocks.zh: 這個原則讓組織能夠集中資源在真正重要的事項上，而不是對所有 QRM 活動採用同樣的審查頻率。
blocks.en: This principle lets an organization focus resources on what really matters, rather than applying the same review frequency to all QRM activities.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：將 Risk Review 嵌入 APR 流程
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: Embedding Risk Review in the APR Process

blocks.zh: CDMO 應在年度產品回顧（APR/PQR）的 SOP 中，明確要求回顧「該產品相關的所有 QRM 文件」：
blocks.en: A CDMO should explicitly require, in its annual product review (APR/PQR) SOP, a review of "all QRM documents related to the product":

blocks.zh: 確認過去一年是否有新的偏差、OOS、客訴觸發 QRM 更新需求
blocks.en: Confirm whether any new deviations, OOS results or complaints in the past year triggered a need to update the QRM

blocks.zh: 回顧既有 Risk Acceptance 決定是否仍然有效（新增了哪些批次數據？有無新的監管動態？）
blocks.en: Review existing Risk Acceptance decisions to see whether they remain valid (what batch data has been added? Are there any new regulatory developments?)

blocks.zh: 若客戶的產品發生了製程或規格的 Change Control，應自動觸發相關 QRM 文件的重新評估
blocks.en: If a client's product undergoes a Change Control for process or specification, it should automatically trigger a re-evaluation of the related QRM documents

blocks.zh: 年度 QRM 審查結果應作為 APR 的獨立章節，提交給高層管理者（Management Review）
blocks.en: The annual QRM review results should be a separate section of the APR and be submitted to senior management (Management Review)

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 某製藥廠的 FMEA 顯示，某道過濾步驟的 RPN = 280（S=8, P=7, D=5）。決定加裝線上粒子計數器以提高 D 值至 2，使 RPN 降至 112。根據 4.4，還需要問什麼問題？這道題的答案如何影響後續行動？
blocks.en: A pharmaceutical plant's FMEA shows an RPN of 280 (S=8, P=7, D=5) for a filtration step. It decides to install an in-line particle counter to improve D to 2, reducing the RPN to 112. According to 4.4, what further question needs to be asked? How does the answer affect the follow-up actions?

blocks.zh: Q9(R1) 新增的「管理主觀性」要求（4.1）如何改變你公司 FMEA 評分會議的操作方式？列出至少 3 項具體的程序改變。
blocks.en: How does the "manage subjectivity" requirement newly added in Q9(R1) (4.1) change the way FMEA scoring meetings are run at your company? List at least 3 specific procedural changes.

blocks.zh: 一個 Risk Assessment 的輸出是「Medium Risk（定性評估）」。在什麼情況下，你會決定需要進一步做定量評估（如 FMECA 計算 RPN）？判斷標準是什麼？
blocks.en: The output of a Risk Assessment is "Medium Risk (qualitative assessment)". Under what circumstances would you decide that a further quantitative assessment is needed (for example, calculating RPN with FMECA)? What are your criteria?

blocks.zh: CDMO 客戶要求縮短無菌灌裝的操作時間（為了提高產能），這是一個什麼類型的 QRM 觸發事件？應啟動哪個子流程（4.2 至 4.6）？涉及哪些跨職能部門（4.1）？
blocks.en: A CDMO client asks to shorten the aseptic filling operation time (to increase capacity). What type of QRM trigger event is this? Which sub-processes (4.2 to 4.6) should be started? Which cross-functional departments (4.1) are involved?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: QRM 是系統性循環過程：涵蓋評估（Assessment）、控制（Control）、溝通（Communication）、審查（Review）四大功能，貫穿整個產品生命週期
blocks.en: QRM is a systematic, cyclical process: it covers four functions, Assessment, Control, Communication and Review, throughout the entire product lifecycle

blocks.zh: 4.1 跨職能責任：QRM 需要跨部門專家協作；決策者需確保流程被定義、部署、審查，並管理主觀性（Q9(R1) 新增要求）
blocks.en: 4.1 Cross-functional responsibility: QRM requires collaboration among experts from different departments; decision makers must ensure the process is defined, deployed and reviewed, and must manage subjectivity (a new requirement in Q9(R1))

blocks.zh: 4.2 啟動四步驟：定義問題 → 收集背景資料 → 指定負責人與資源 → 設定時程與決策層級
blocks.en: 4.2 Four steps to initiate: define the problem → gather background information → assign responsible persons and resources → set the timeline and decision-making level

blocks.zh: 4.3 風險評估三要素：危害識別（What?）→ 風險分析（P × S × D）→ 風險評估（與標準比較）；輸出可為定量（RPN）或定性（High/Medium/Low）
blocks.en: 4.3 Three elements of risk assessment: hazard identification (What?) → risk analysis (P × S × D) → risk evaluation (comparison against criteria); the output may be quantitative (RPN) or qualitative (High/Medium/Low)

blocks.zh: 4.3 不確定性：來自知識缺口和製程變異；應在 Risk Assessment Report 中明確揭示假設和不確定性來源
blocks.en: 4.3 Uncertainty: arises from knowledge gaps and process variability; assumptions and sources of uncertainty should be clearly disclosed in the Risk Assessment Report

blocks.zh: 4.4 風險控制關鍵點：降低風險措施可能引入新風險，必須重新進行風險評估（「內迴圈」）；風險接受是有意識的、有文件記錄的決定
blocks.en: 4.4 Key points of risk control: risk reduction measures may introduce new risks, so the risk assessment must be redone (the "inner loop"); risk acceptance is a conscious, documented decision

blocks.zh: 4.5 風險溝通：可在任何階段發生（虛線箭頭）；並非每個 Risk Acceptance 都需要溝通；文件化是核心要求
blocks.en: 4.5 Risk communication: can occur at any stage (dashed arrows); not every Risk Acceptance needs to be communicated; documentation is the core requirement

blocks.zh: 4.6 風險審查：計畫性和非計畫性事件均可觸發；審查頻率應與風險等級成比例；應嵌入 APR 等既有品質系統流程
blocks.en: 4.6 Risk review: can be triggered by both planned and unplanned events; review frequency should be proportionate to the risk level; should be embedded in existing quality system processes such as the APR
